info.name: LIV-162 Grant lifecycle (requires provisioned S01 and real S02 binding)

exec: pm.test('PENDING grant is not effective', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(d.verificationStatus).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(d.effective).to.eql(false); pm.collectionVariables.set('grantId', d.grantId); });

pm.test('Grant verified with live binding', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.verificationStatus).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(d.effective).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.verifiedBindingRevision).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 04 Lead sees repository in access context

exec: pm.test('Verified repository is effective', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const scopes=pm.response.json().data.workspaceGrants; pm.expect(scopes.some(w => w.repositoryIds.includes(pm.environment.get('repositoryConnectionId')))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 06 Revoked Grant disappears from access context

exec: pm.test('Revoked repository is not effective', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const scopes=pm.response.json().data.workspaceGrants; pm.expect(scopes.some(w => w.repositoryIds.includes(pm.environment.get('repositoryConnectionId')))).to.eql(false); });
